pageTitle: Diet Scan AI - AI-Powered Nutrition Tracker
heroSubtitle: Track Your Nutrition With Just a Photo
heroDescription: Looking for a free iOS app to identify food calories by photo? Try Diet Scan AI! Optimized for users worldwide, it easily records calories, protein, fat, carbs, GI, and purine index for home-cooked meals, takeout, or packaged foods just by taking a picture. Powered by advanced AI deep learning, it's more than a calorie counter—it's your smart diet diary and nutrition partner, helping you achieve your weight loss, blood sugar control, or healthy eating goals effortlessly.
featurePhotoAnalysisText: Take a photo of your meal and get instant nutrition information.
featureNutritionTrackingText: Monitor calories, protein, carbs, and fat intake daily.
featureGlycemicIndexText: Track the GI of foods to manage blood sugar levels.
featureMealHistoryText: Review past meals and track your nutrition trends over time.
featureWaterTrackerText: Log water, tea, coffee, and sparkling water intake.
featureHealthTipsText: Get suggestions for a more balanced diet based on your eating habits.
step1Text: Capture your meal with your phone's camera.
step2Text: Our AI analyzes the food and provides detailed nutrition facts.
step3Text: Log your meals and monitor your progress towards a healthier lifestyle.
faq1Question: Is Diet Scan AI free to use?
faq1Answer: Yes, Diet Scan AI is free to download and use. We offer optional premium features for advanced users.
faq2Question: What platforms does Diet Scan AI support?
faq2Answer: Currently, Diet Scan AI is available exclusively on iOS. An Android version is in development.
faq3Question: How accurate is the food recognition?
faq3Answer: Our AI is trained on a massive dataset of food images to provide highly accurate results. Accuracy improves over time as more users contribute data.
faq4Question: Can I track my water intake?
faq4Answer: Absolutely! You can easily log your intake of water, tea, coffee, and other beverages.
